subject: humanities
passage: The Pakistani artist Sadequain, who lived from 1930 to 1987, is remembered both as a painter and as a calligrapher who turned verses of Urdu and Persian poetry into bold, angular images. Many of his best-known works were produced on a monumental scale, including large murals for public buildings in Pakistan and India. At the time of his death, Sadequain ______ on a vast painting for the ceiling of Frere Hall in Karachi; the unfinished work, which depicts the earth and the heavens, can still be seen there today.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "At the time of his death" refers to a moment in 1987, and the work was in progress at that moment, as "the unfinished work" shows. An action in progress at a specific past moment takes the past progressive, "was still working."
explanation.A: Incorrect. The present tense "works" doesn't fit an action at a past moment, the time of his death in 1987.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The present perfect progressive "has been working" suggests the work continues into the present, but Sadequain died in 1987.
explanation.C: Correct. The past progressive "was still working" shows that the painting was in progress when he died.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The future progressive "will be working" refers to the future, but the event is in the past.
